spec_match.rationale: Exercises the shipped pipeline literally: ISO-BMFF files with iamf sample entries (Chromium's own test assets, iacb box read to confirm iamf.000.000.Opus) appended through MediaSource/SourceBuffer with the muxed avc1.640028 mime.

interactive.rationale: Sample selector, Load & append driving the real seven-step pipeline with per-step verdicts and a timestamped log, native video controls, and a Play button that only enables after a real successful append.

blurb_alignment.rationale: Index promises fetching a real IAMF asset through a SourceBuffer with honest failure modes; the page does exactly that with local same-origin samples.

edge_cases.rationale: Distinct honest states for no-MSE, isTypeSupported false (still continues to show the real addSourceBuffer NotSupportedError), sample-unreachable with retry, append error, media element error, and autoplay rejection.

references.rationale: Links chromestatus.com/feature/5113656292540416, the IAMF spec, MSE spec, and the Chromium media/test/data sample source with license attribution.

conformance.rationale: The feature suite's isTypeSupported assertions are exactly the gate this page hits first; they fail honestly here and pass only where the pipeline could proceed.

runtime_evidence.rationale: Headless Chromium 141 CDP autorun, desktop 1280x800 + mobile 360x740 DPR3: fetch of ../samples/ returned HTTP 200 with 117,384 bytes, sourceopen fired, addSourceBuffer threw a real NotSupportedError, fallback banner and red step markers rendered, zero console errors (environmental fonts failure only). Actual IAMF decode/playback is unverifiable in this sandbox — explicitly not claimed.

telemetry_health.rationale: Separate asserts for append-ok, playing, unsupported-fallback (reason-tagged), sample-unreachable, media-error, play-rejected, and pipeline-error; fallback never reported as pass.

design_system.rationale: CSS variables throughout; disabled-button override sets both background and color; done-step text switched from emerald (fails AA on white) to black with an emerald glyph; rose text/border pairs measured >=5:1.

accessibility.rationale: Labelled native select (with visible filename description), buttons with disabled semantics, ordered list of steps with aria-label, aria-live pipeline state and log, video element with controls and aria-label; AT-tree inspection deferred (no MCP).

mobile_desktop_parity.rationale: Controls wrap, steps and log wrap long mime tokens, video is fluid with aspect-ratio; CDP shows scrollWidth==innerWidth at 360x740 DPR3 and 1280x800 after shortening select option labels that had forced a 395px minimum.

openQuestions.title: Verify the audible success path on an IAMF-enabled Chrome 152 build
openQuestions.detail: Confirm appendBuffer of these muxed fragmented MP4s (which end with an mfra box) completes without a SourceBuffer parse error, duration/buffered populate, and decoded IAMF audio is audible for both the stereo and 7.1.4 mixes; then update this critique's runtime_evidence to pass.

openQuestions.title: Surface the selected mix presentation when introspection ships
openQuestions.detail: If Chrome exposes audioTracks or mix-presentation/output-layout introspection for IAMF, add those to the live readouts so the 7.1.4 downmix behaviour is visible rather than implied.

guidanceConsulted.query: media playback progress loading error retry states accessible live region
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Expose loading/progress/error/retry states as text via live regions and keep media controls native.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Pipeline state dd and log output are aria-live polite; every failure state is labelled text with a retry path; the video keeps native controls.

guidanceConsulted.query: responsive results table readout mobile no horizontal overflow
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Let intrinsic minimum sizes drive reflow and eliminate elements whose min-content width exceeds the mobile viewport.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Long select option labels (min-content 395px) shortened with the filename moved to a wrapping description line; steps/log/banner use overflow-wrap:anywhere; readouts use auto-fit minmax grid.
guidanceConsulted.evidence: cdp-check METRICS overflow:false at 360x740 DPR3 and 1280x800

summary: The pipeline page performs the real MSE append of Chromium's IAMF test assets with per-step honest verdicts. In this non-IAMF sandbox it was verified end-to-end down the honest failure path (HTTP 200 fetch, real NotSupportedError, labelled fallback) on both viewport classes with a clean console; the audible success path is explicitly deferred to an IAMF-enabled Chrome 152 build.
